rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is violently broken into pieces.

example.traditional: 佢一唔小心將隻玻璃杯打碎咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 zek3 bo1 lei4 bui1 daa2 seoi3 zo2

rows.note: Use this for destroying, damaging, or making an object or system unusable rather than physically breaking it into pieces.

example.english: This virus can shatter the whole computer system.
example.traditional: 呢個病毒可以破壞成個電腦系統。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 beng6 duk6 ho2 ji5 po3 waai6 seng4 go3 din6 nou5 hai6 tung2

rows.note: Use this colloquial construction when an event leaves a person emotionally devastated or unable to cope.

example.english: The breakup really did shatter them emotionally.
example.traditional: 呢次失戀真係搞到佢崩潰。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 sat1 lyun2 zan1 hai6 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 bang1 kui2
